'''Or Kono Arena''' was a gladiatorial arena located in the heart of [[Gorma-Koss]], the largest [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] settlement on [[Voss]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in pursuit of the Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]], visited the arena and after defeating several rounds of beasts, won enough respect from the Gormak, who told him that Redrish went into the [[Dark Heart]] of the [[Nightmare Lands]].<ref name="Captive Audience" /> It also housed a prison, which held various Gormak prisoners, including [[Hadrik]], who was later freed by [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]].<ref name="Necessary Sacrifice">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Necessary Sacrifice|Voss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Or Kono Arena appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Captive Audience" />
